meta.name: Built-in Core Compendium
meta.note: Contains class/subclass/spell data in importable JSON form for this app. Extend this file with your own local source text as needed.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.description: A straightforward martial specialist built on superior athletics and critical hits.

subclasses.name: Battle Master
subclasses.description: A tactical fighter who uses superiority dice and maneuvers.

subclasses.name: Eldritch Knight
subclasses.description: A martial fighter blending steel and arcane spellcasting.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.description: Hurl a bubble of acid at one or two targets; each target must make a Dexterity save or take acid damage.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: Hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object; on a hit it takes fire damage.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: Touch an object to shed bright and dim light for 1 hour.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: Create a spectral hand that can manipulate objects at a distance.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.description: Perform minor magical tricks and harmless sensory effects.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.description: A frigid beam deals cold damage and slows the target's speed.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: A reactive magical barrier grants +5 AC until your next turn and blocks magic missile.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: Create three glowing darts of force that automatically hit targets.

spells.name: Absorb Elements
spells.description: Capture incoming elemental energy to gain resistance and empower your next melee hit.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: A 15-foot cone of fire forces Dexterity saves and deals fire damage.

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.description: Hurl a sphere of elemental energy; choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder damage.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: Sense magic within range and identify magical auras while concentrating.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.description: Summon a spirit in animal form to serve as your familiar.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: Roll hit points affected and put creatures to magical sleep.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.description: A wave of thunderous force pushes creatures and deals thunder damage on a failed save.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Briefly wreathe yourself in mist and teleport up to 30 feet.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.description: Create illusory duplicates that can cause attacks to miss you.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.description: Create three rays of fire and make spell attacks against targets.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.description: A sudden loud ringing deals thunder damage in an area, especially effective against inorganic materials.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.description: Paralyze a humanoid target on a failed Wisdom save while concentration lasts.
